definitions.short: to slink , i.e. (by implication) to fear , or (causatively) be formidable
definitions.full: H1763. dechal [ דְּחַל ] verb fear (so ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew II. זָחַל ]; — Pe`al Participle active plural דָּֽחְלִין Dan 5:19 , with מִןקֳֿדָם of king, 6:27 , id. of God; passive דְּחִיל terrible 2:31 , feminine דְּחִילָה 7:7 , 19 . Pa`el Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix וִידֵחֲלִנַּנִי Dan 4:2 the dream made me afraid.
